• Brand introduction:

Value Blinds was founded by a home decor industry veteran with over 12 years of experience who understood the frustration of overpriced, complicated window treatments. After personally outfitting 20+ windows and discovering the overwhelming costs and complexity at big-box stores, she created Value Blinds to make high-quality window treatments accessible without the inflated cost. Based in Portland, Oregon, we combine our founder's appreciation for quality fabrics (inspired by her grandmother's traditional weaving) with modern convenience to deliver sustainable, affordable window solutions that make sense.


• Product description:

We offer premium custom-made blinds and shades designed to make your home beautiful and comfortable. Our collection includes motorized smart blinds and shade such as cellular shades, zebra shades, natural woven shades, bamboo/wood blinds, faux wood blinds, Roman shades, roller shades, and our summer bestsellers – outdoor shades and pergolas perfect for patios and outdoor living spaces. Most products feature child-safe cordless designs, smart home integration options, and environmentally-friendly materials certified by Greenguard, OEKO-TEX, and FSC. With free samples, perfect fit measuring guides, DIY-friendly installation/referred local professional installers, and best-in-class warranty, we make window treatment shopping simple and stress-free.


• USP (Unique Selling Point):

🏡 "Window Treatments Made Simple": We eliminated the confusion and markup of traditional blind shopping 👩‍💼 12+ Years of Expertise: Founded by a home decor industry veteran who's been where your customers are 🌱 Certified Sustainable: Greenguard, OEKO-TEX, and FSC certified – safe for families and the planet ☀️ Motorized and smart options: most of our products have these options  💰 Value blinds: quality materials and products without the premium


• Payment terms:

  • Commission Rates: 10% tier 1 (Roller), and up to tier 4 
  • Cookie Duration: 30 days
  • Payment Schedule: Monthly 
  • Payment Methods: PayPal, Direct Deposit
  • Minimum Payout: $50
  • Commission Basis: Product subtotal (excludes discounts, tax & shipping)


• Other information:

☀️ Summer Opportunity: Outdoor shades and pergolas are trending! Average outdoor order value has higher commissions🎯 Perfect Partners: Home improvement/decor bloggers, influencers, outdoor living enthusiasts, DIY content creators, interior designers, real estate professionals, and  handymen🎁 Affiliate Support: Exclusive seasonal promotions, dedicated support, and clear growth path through our tier system🌟 Success Story: "Blinds and shades should be an easy and affordable upgrade" – share our mission with your audience📧 Direct Support: Our founder personally reviews top performer strategies quarterly⏰ Quick Approval: 24-48 hours to start earning

Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions

Effective Date: July 1, 2025
Last Updated: July 1, 2025

These Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions ("Agreement") constitute a legal agreement between Value Blinds LLC ("Company," "we," "us," or "our") and you ("Affiliate," "you," or "your"), governing your participation in the Value Blinds Affiliate Program ("Program").

By applying to or participating in our Program, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions.

1. Definitions

  • "Affiliate" means any individual or entity approved to participate in the Program
  • "Affiliate Link" means the unique tracking URL provided to track referrals
  • "Commission" means the payment earned for Qualified Sales
  • "Qualified Sale" means a completed purchase that meets all Program requirements
  • "Cookie Duration" means the 30-day period during which referrals are tracked
  • "Content" means any promotional materials, text, images, or media used to promote our products
  • "Fraudulent Activity" means any deceptive, misleading, or illegal activity as defined in Section 3.4
  • "Sub-affiliate" means any third party recruited by an Affiliate (not permitted unless approved)
  • "Return Period" means the 30-day period after delivery during which customers may request returns per our Return & Refund Policy

2. Enrollment & Acceptance

2.1 Application

  • You must submit a complete and accurate application
  • We reserve the right to accept or reject any application at our sole discretion
  • Approval typically occurs within 24-48 hours
  • We may request additional information or documentation

2.2 Eligibility Requirements

To participate in the Program, you must:

  • Be at least 18 years old
  • Have an active website, blog, or social media presence with original content
  • Have a minimum of 500 monthly visitors or followers
  • Comply with all applicable laws and regulations
  • Not be located in countries subject to U.S. trade sanctions
  • Maintain appropriate disclosures per FTC guidelines
  • Not have been previously terminated from our Program

2.3 Account Information

  • You must provide accurate, current, and complete information
  • You must update your information within 7 days of any changes
  • One account per person or entity unless otherwise approved
  • Multiple account creation will result in immediate termination

2.4 Identity Verification

We may require at any time:

  • Government-issued photo ID
  • Proof of website ownership
  • Tax documentation (W-9/W-8BEN)
  • Phone or video verification
  • Business registration documents
  • Social media account verification
  • Proof of traffic sources

2.5 New Affiliate Probationary Period

All new affiliates are subject to:

  • 90-day probationary period with enhanced monitoring
  • Manual review of first 5 sales
  • Commission rate of 10% during probation (Tier 1)
  • Graduation to appropriate tier based on performance after probation
  • First payment may be delayed for verification

3. Commission Structure

3.1 Commission Rates

  • Tier 1 (Entry Level): 10% of net sale amount - First 90 days or up to 5 sales
  • Tier 2 (Growth): 12% of net sale amount - 6-15 sales/month OR $3,000 monthly revenue
  • Tier 3 (Established): 15% of net sale amount - 16-30 sales/month OR $8,000 monthly revenue
  • Tier 4 (VIP): Custom rates for exceptional performers meeting special criteria
  • Net sale amount excludes taxes, shipping, and returns
  • Tier evaluation occurs monthly based on previous month's performance
  • Affiliates qualify for higher tiers by meeting EITHER sales count OR revenue threshold

3.2 Qualified Sales

A sale qualifies for commission when:

  • Customer completes purchase through your Affiliate Link
  • Payment is successfully processed and cleared
  • Order is not returned within the 30-day Return Period as defined in our Return & Refund Policy
  • Purchase is not fraudulent or disputed
  • Customer is new or hasn't purchased in 12 months
  • Transaction passes our fraud detection systems
  • Customer shipping address is verified
  • Minimum order value of $100 (before taxes and shipping)
  • Order value does not exceed $5,000 without prior approval

3.3 Excluded Items

No commissions are paid on:

  • Taxes, shipping, or handling charges
  • Returned or refunded items
  • Gift cards or store credits
  • Employee purchases
  • Your own purchases or those of immediate family
  • Wholesale or bulk orders (unless pre-approved)
  • Orders using employee discount codes
  • Test orders or development transactions

3.4 Fraudulent Activity

The following constitute fraud and result in immediate termination and forfeiture of all commissions:

  • Self-referrals or purchases through your own affiliate link
  • Creating fake accounts or identities to generate commissions
  • Using stolen credit cards or payment information
  • Cookie stuffing, pixel stuffing, or forced clicks
  • Typosquatting or URL hijacking
  • Using misleading browser extensions or toolbars
  • Using bots, scripts, or automated systems to generate traffic or sales
  • Incentivizing purchases through cashback or rewards without approval
  • Bid manipulation, click fraud, or impression fraud
  • Pattern of returns exceeding 20% of purchases
  • Purchasing products for resale without authorization
  • Using spam, unsolicited messages, or deceptive practices
  • Misrepresenting our products, prices, or policies
  • Creating fake reviews or testimonials

4. Payment Terms

4.1 Payment Schedule

  • Commissions are calculated monthly
  • Payments are processed by the 15th of each month for the previous month's earnings
  • Minimum payout threshold: $50
  • Balances below threshold roll over to the next month
  • New affiliates: First payment may be subject to additional verification

4.2 Payment Methods

  • PayPal (preferred)
  • Direct deposit (U.S. affiliates only)
  • Check (additional $5 processing fee)
  • Wire transfer (international, $40 fee)

4.3 Tax Obligations

  • You are responsible for all applicable taxes on commission income
  • U.S. affiliates earning $600 annually will receive Form 1099
  • International affiliates must comply with local tax requirements
  • We may withhold taxes as required by law

4.4 Commission Reversals and Clawbacks

We may reverse or clawback commissions for:

  • Orders returned within the standard 30-day Return Period
  • Returns accepted beyond 30 days due to defects or company error (up to 90 days)
  • Chargebacks or payment disputes (up to 90 days)
  • Fraudulent transactions discovered after payment (up to 180 days)
  • Violation of terms discovered after payment
  • You authorize us to deduct amounts from future payments
  • Returns due to defects or our error will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis

4.5 Payment Holds and Security

We may hold payments for:

  • Suspicious activity pending investigation
  • Verification of traffic sources
  • Unusual sales patterns
  • High-risk geographic locations
  • First-time high-value commissions
  • Random compliance audits

5. Affiliate Responsibilities

5.1 Promotional Methods

Permitted Methods:

  • Original website/blog content
  • Social media posts (with proper disclosures)
  • Email marketing (to your confirmed opt-in list only)
  • YouTube videos and reviews
  • Comparison shopping sites (pre-approved)
  • Display advertising (with approval)

Prohibited Methods:

  • Spam or unsolicited communications of any kind
  • Paid search ads bidding on our trademarked terms or variations
  • Cookie stuffing, pixel stuffing, or forced clicks
  • Misleading or deceptive content
  • Incentivized traffic or cashback sites (unless approved)
  • Adult, violent, or offensive content sites
  • Adware, spyware, or malware distribution
  • Pop-ups, pop-unders, or aggressive advertising
  • Iframe or hidden redirects
  • Negative SEO tactics against competitors
  • Social media spam or fake engagement

5.2 Content Standards

All promotional content must:

  • Be accurate, truthful, and not misleading
  • Include proper FTC disclosures
  • Not make unauthorized claims about our products
  • Maintain professional standards
  • Not infringe on any third-party rights
  • Be appropriate for general audiences
  • Reflect current pricing and availability
  • Not create unrealistic expectations
  • Reference our current Return & Refund Policy when discussing returns

5.3 FTC Compliance

You must clearly disclose your affiliate relationship:

  • Disclosures must be clear and conspicuous
  • Must appear before affiliate links
  • Use explicit language (e.g., "As an affiliate, I earn from qualifying purchases")
  • Video content must include verbal and written disclosure
  • Social media posts must include disclosure in the post itself
  • Email must include disclosure near links

5.4 Traffic Quality Requirements

All referred traffic must:

  • Have genuine purchase intent
  • Come from approved sources only
  • Show normal browsing patterns
  • Not use methods to mask user location
  • Have conversion rates between 0.5-10%
  • Show diverse IP addresses and devices
  • Display normal session durations (30 seconds - 30 minutes)
  • Pass bot detection systems

5.5 Brand Protection

You agree to:

  • Not bid on our trademarked terms in any form
  • Not register domains containing our trademarks
  • Not create social media accounts impersonating us
  • Not use our brand in email "from" fields
  • Not create apps using our name
  • Protect our reputation in all activities

6. Intellectual Property

6.1 License Grant

We grant you a limited, non-exclusive, revocable license to use our:

  • Approved logos and trademarks
  • Product images and descriptions
  • Marketing materials
  • Only for Program purposes during participation

6.2 Restrictions

You may not:

  • Modify our trademarks, logos, or materials
  • Register domains containing our trademarks
  • Create derivative works without permission
  • Use our content after termination
  • Represent yourself as our employee or agent
  • Sublicense our materials to others
  • Use our intellectual property in meta tags
  • Create confusingly similar marks

6.3 Content Ownership

  • We retain all rights to our intellectual property
  • You retain rights to your original content
  • You grant us license to use your testimonials
  • We may showcase you as a program participant

7. Tracking & Reporting

7.1 Tracking Technology

  • We use cookies and tracking pixels to attribute sales
  • Cookie duration: 30 days from initial click
  • Last-click attribution model applies
  • Cross-device tracking may be implemented

7.2 Reporting Access

  • Real-time reporting via affiliate dashboard
  • Monthly performance summaries
  • Commission statements
  • Click and conversion tracking
  • Downloadable reports for tax purposes

7.3 Tracking Disputes

  • Report tracking issues within 30 days
  • Provide supporting documentation
  • We'll investigate in good faith
  • Our records are final for payment purposes

7.4 Compliance Monitoring

We reserve the right to:

  • Audit your promotional methods at any time
  • Request traffic source verification
  • Analyze conversion patterns for anomalies
  • Require proof of promotional activities
  • Mystery shop your referral sources
  • Use third-party fraud detection services
  • Review your website/content without notice
  • Monitor social media activities
  • Track customer journey paths
  • Implement device fingerprinting

8. Relationship of Parties

8.1 Independent Contractor

  • You are an independent contractor, not an employee
  • No employment benefits or protections apply
  • You're responsible for your own expenses
  • No authority to bind us to any obligations
  • No territorial rights granted

8.2 No Exclusivity

  • You may participate in other affiliate programs
  • We may work with other affiliates
  • No territorial exclusivity granted
  • We may sell directly in any market

8.3 Sub-affiliates

  • Sub-affiliate recruitment is prohibited unless approved
  • You're responsible for any approved sub-affiliates
  • No multi-level marketing structures permitted

9. Confidentiality

9.1 Confidential Information

You agree to keep confidential:

  • Non-public commission rates
  • Sales data and analytics
  • Customer information
  • Internal communications
  • Program strategies and updates
  • Technical implementation details
  • Other affiliates' performance

9.2 Duration

Confidentiality obligations survive termination for 3 years.

10. Privacy & Data Protection

10.1 Customer Data

  • You may not collect our customers' personal information
  • Any data collected must comply with applicable privacy laws
  • You must have your own privacy policy
  • Customer data remains our property
  • No retargeting our customers without permission

10.2 GDPR Compliance

If you promote to EU residents:

  • Obtain necessary consents
  • Provide required disclosures
  • Honor data subject rights
  • Notify us of any data breaches immediately
  • Maintain records of consent

10.3 CCPA Compliance

For California residents:

  • No sale of personal information
  • Honor opt-out requests
  • Provide required notices
  • Maintain required records

11. Termination

11.1 Termination Rights

Either party may terminate this Agreement:

  • For any reason with 7 days written notice
  • Immediately for breach of terms
  • Immediately for fraudulent activity
  • Immediately for brand damage

11.2 Effect of Termination

Upon termination:

  • Your affiliate links will be deactivated immediately
  • Pending qualified commissions will be paid (unless fraud)
  • You must remove all our content and links within 24 hours
  • License to use our materials ends immediately
  • Return any confidential materials
  • Cooperation with final accounting

11.3 Survival

These sections survive termination:

  • Confidentiality
  • Indemnification
  • Limitation of Liability
  • Commission Reversals
  • Intellectual Property

11.4 Red Flag Activities for Immediate Termination

We monitor for suspicious patterns including:

  • Sudden unexplained traffic spikes (>300% increase)
  • Abnormally high conversion rates (>10%)
  • Multiple orders from same IP/device
  • Unusual geographic concentrations
  • Orders just above commission thresholds
  • Consistent order values
  • Purchases immediately before cutoff dates
  • High cancellation rates after commission payment
  • Use of proxy servers or VPNs
  • Disabled JavaScript or cookie blocking

12. Warranties & Representations

You represent and warrant that:

  • You have the right to enter this Agreement
  • Your content doesn't infringe any third-party rights
  • You'll comply with all applicable laws
  • Your promotional methods are ethical and legal
  • Information provided to us is accurate
  • You have necessary licenses and permits
  • Your website contains original content
  • You're not a competitor or affiliated with competitors

13. Indemnification

You agree to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the Company, its officers, directors, employees, agents, and affiliates from any claims, damages, losses, liabilities, or expenses (including attorney fees) arising from:

  • Your breach of this Agreement
  • Your promotional activities
  • Your website or content
  • Your violation of any laws
  • Third-party claims related to your activities
  • Customer disputes from your referrals
  • Your negligence or misconduct
  • Tax obligations

14. Limitation of Liability

14.1 Disclaimer

THE PROGRAM IS PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTIES OF ANY KIND, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO MERCHANTABILITY OR FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.

14.2 Liability Limit

IN NO EVENT SHALL WE BE LIABLE FOR:

  • Indirect, incidental, or consequential damages
  • Lost profits or opportunities
  • Damages exceeding commissions earned in the past 12 months
  • Technical failures or tracking errors
  • Changes to the Program

15. Dispute Resolution

15.1 Informal Resolution

Parties agree to attempt informal resolution for 30 days before formal proceedings.

15.2 Arbitration

Any disputes shall be resolved through binding arbitration under AAA Commercial Arbitration Rules.

  • Location: Portland, Oregon
  • One arbitrator
  • English language
  • Parties bear own costs

15.3 Governing Law

This Agreement is governed by the laws of Oregon, without regard to conflict of law principles.

15.4 Injunctive Relief

We may seek injunctive relief for violations of confidentiality or intellectual property provisions.

16. Modifications

16.1 Changes to Terms

  • We may modify these terms with 30 days notice
  • Material changes require renewed consent
  • Continued participation constitutes acceptance
  • Notice via email and dashboard

16.2 Program Changes

We reserve the right to:

  • Modify commission rates (with 30 days notice)
  • Change payment methods or schedules
  • Update promotional guidelines
  • Suspend or terminate the Program
  • Add or remove features
  • Adjust tracking methods

17. General Provisions

17.1 Entire Agreement

This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between parties and supersedes all prior agreements.

17.2 Severability

If any provision is deemed invalid, the remainder continues in effect.

17.3 Waiver

No waiver is effective unless in writing and signed by the waiving party.

17.4 Assignment

You may not assign your rights without our prior written consent. We may assign freely.

17.5 Force Majeure

Neither party is liable for delays due to circumstances beyond reasonable control.

17.6 Notices

All notices must be in writing via email to designated addresses or certified mail.

17.7 Interpretation

Headings are for convenience only. "Including" means "including but not limited to."

17.8 Relationship to Other Policies

This Agreement works in conjunction with our Return & Refund Policy, which governs customer returns and refunds. Affiliates should familiarize themselves with our customer-facing policies.

18. Anti-Spam Policy

18.1 Compliance Required

You must comply with:

  • CAN-SPAM Act (US)
  • CASL (Canada)
  • GDPR (EU)
  • All applicable anti-spam laws worldwide

18.2 Email Marketing Rules

If promoting via email:

  • Only email your own confirmed opted-in subscribers
  • Include clear unsubscribe mechanisms
  • Honor opt-out requests within 48 hours
  • No purchased, rented, or harvested lists
  • Include physical mailing address
  • Accurate subject lines and headers
  • Maintain opt-in records for 3 years

18.3 SMS/Text Marketing

  • Requires explicit prior written consent
  • Must include opt-out instructions
  • Standard message rates disclosure required

19. Prohibited States/Countries

The Program is not available to residents of:

  • Countries subject to U.S. trade sanctions (currently: Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria, Russia, Belarus)
  • Crimea, Donetsk, and Luhansk regions
  • States where prohibited by law
  • Jurisdictions requiring special licenses we don't possess

20. Compliance Certifications

20.1 Annual Certification

Affiliates earning $10,000 annually must provide:

  • Annual compliance certification
  • Updated tax documentation
  • Traffic source attestation
  • FTC compliance confirmation

20.2 Insurance Requirements

Affiliates earning $50,000 annually must maintain:

  • General liability insurance ($1 million)
  • Errors & omissions coverage
  • Cyber liability insurance
  • Proof of coverage upon request
